title: IAM3D & RC Cars
description: IAM3D is a 3D-printing robotics challenge (1st Place) and RC Cars Challenge by EFx ASME tests RC car design and manufacturing skills (2nd Place). Two engineering competitions showcasing our team's design and performance excellence.

title: ROV2017
description: The 2017 ROV Competition, organized by the MATE Center, was a global event promoting innovation in underwater robotics. Teams from around the world built and operated ROVs to complete complex underwater missions. The competition aimed to inspire students to pursue STEM careers through real-world challenges.

title: Minesweepers Competition
description: The Minesweepers Competition is a global event focused on developing robotic solutions for landmine detection and removal. It promotes innovation and teamwork among international teams to build safe and efficient systems for dangerous environments. The competition supports technological advancement in humanitarian demining.

title: Micromouse Competition
description: The Micromouse competition challenges small autonomous robots to navigate a 16×16 maze and reach the center on their own. Robots explore the maze, detect walls, and track their position to find the goal. After mapping the maze, they race through the optimal path in the shortest time.
